## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (failing first), `pnpm test` / `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm lint` pass
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) if published behavior of `mcp-apps-studio` or `@mcp-apps-studio/widget-runtime` changed
- [ ] Matching spec in `openspec/specs/` updated if behavior changed (`pnpm openspec validate --all --strict`)
- [ ] Docs (README, `--help`, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) updated if users or contributors will notice
